Eval API made consistent with the training API, in this Task (Jack Heart: "make it consistent where there is no reason not to", "make it match training but we also make it easy to use our Matchup APIs"; on the shape: "i thik thats probably right?", tentative, show at demo). Shape in scratch/questions.md "Eval API made consistent with training": author function + author config, evaluation(arena, config=...) like training(train, config=); inside, with evaluating(benchmark) as run: run.play(play); EvalRun(Run); one config per job; run.play replaces hold/evaluate; no lines= (run reads lines); rollups on the Benchmark; stopping/Stopped/resume as training; tournament types unchanged; warning aliases until 0.5.
